correctness.evidence: Third Murnaghan–Nakayama recursion recomputed 155 integer split rows, dimension sums, unique degree maxima 3/4/5 and full S6 staircase symmetric support.

originality.evidence: Finite n≤8 non-hook three-row table; Bessenrodt–Bowman 2023 has general framework, small-depth/two-row formulas and Saxl refinement.

scientific_value.evidence: Exact finite data for an open parametric splitting family, with no general formula or global maximum.

limitations: No claim beyond nine source partitions.
